title: Fabulous day trip to Montserrat followed by wine tasting in the vineyard.
text:
A fabulous day trip with Feliciano. Highly recommended. We left early at 07:45 hrs(small group) and got to Montserrat Monastary before the crowds. Fabulous visit to the Church of Montserrat, the Black Madonna (we paid extra on the spot at 9:30 hrs.) We did not want the funicular trip as this is not include and other tours provide this option. 
Then on to the winery lunch part of our tour. Exceptional. Thank you Georgina our knowledgeable guide in the Penedes region and the local family run winery. Cava production at its best. Then for an open air lunch in the vineyard. What an exceptional expe
author: Martina_C

title: 100% recommended!
text: What a wonderful way to spend a day: beautiful scenery, great food and wine, and rich stories about history and culture!   My personal favourite moment was the disgorgement of the cava bottle! Absolute gem of a tour, thank you Feliciano and Georgina!
author: 475tuijam

title: Awesome Day Trip into the Countryside
text: We had a great day visiting the Montserrat Monastery (before the crowds!) and a cava winery. The best part was the lunch overlooking the vineyards. The food and wine were delicious. And our guide Feliciano was so knowledgeable and fun. Such a wonderful tour!
author: MBT36

title: Amazing day trip from Barcelona!
text: What an amazing tour! We were the only ones on the tour (note all of their tours are small group experiences). Our tour guide Feliciano was fantastic. Super friendly, knowledgeable, professional, and a wealth of knowledge about Barcelona, wine, history and culture. He made us feel so special and welcomed. The early start to Montserrat is completely worth it to arrive before all the crowds. Montserrat is stunning and worth the trip. We then went to Joan Segura Pujades winery where Georgina treated us like honored guests (even the owner made time to greet us). We tried 5 different wines and cava
author: dawnhF8349FT

title: A must do when in Spain!
text: A wonderful combination of a spiritual experience and a day at a great winery.  The Monserrat and the Monestary were amazing as was our guide Luke.  Then the winery!  Experience like no other.  Great Cava and still wine along with a beautifully prepared lunch by the wife of the winemaker Juan.  Georgie was the bubble of the tour as she did a tremendous job guiding us through the wines.
author: Jason_G

title: Wine/ Montserrat tour
text: A fantastic experience. Georgina and the staff at the winery are such good hosts. Come ready to eat. Ariana is a great guide, very knowledgeable about the area and the history. I would do this again
author: Z7248FLmikeb

title: Day trip worth taking
text: An awesome experience worth the time. Our guide, Ariana, was very knowledgeable and spoke very clear English. She kept it interesting and fun. I have visited many wineries and vinyards. This experience was one of my favorites. Monsarat is beautiful.  Highly recommended day trip from Barcelona. And, you return in plenty of time to enjoy the afternoon and evening in the city.
author: mary_g

title: Well worth the trip!
text: Fabulous experience! Feliciano was a great guide. Fun personality and informative! This was Our 3rd Devour tour on this trip and each one was spot on! Wine and cava tasting was really good. If it wasn’t so expensive to ship we would have ordered some wine! Montserrat is as beautiful and an interesting stop. Nice to get out of the city. Our driver was very good and comfortable! I liked that since driver was late due to an accident, they didn’t shorten the time we had at each stop.
author: dutchmamaof4

title: Relaxing day with good wine!
text:
Dom was and amazing guide. Full of humor and information.  Unlike most guides Dom knew when to talk and when to chill on the bus. 

The winery was also top notch. Give it a go, nice to get out of Barca and see the countryside.
author: Cowie44

title: Perfecto!
text: Feliciano was awesome and this is one of the best tours I have been on in a long time.
